correctness.rationale: The explicit logit antiderivative yields the four endpoint slopes and exact intercepts. Under positive payoff derivatives, the two potentials are strictly convex and proper, giving all and only one simple regular closed orbit per superminimal energy. Original-time period equals the energy derivative of canonical enclosed area and exactly equals an inverse-width derivative convolution. Positive monotone integrable defects determine the full constant term, with convolution remainder tending to zero. Inverse-branch quadrant times give the leading weights and finite-logit-strip estimates show weak concentration at the four corners. Analytic proof covers every parameter in the stated strict domain; symbolic and physical-time numerical checks from the attached script corroborate but do not replace it.

value.rationale: A natural observable in cyclic two-population games is the original-time residence near the four pure-strategy profiles. The theorem determines the complete limiting joint measure, proves its unexpected independence in asymmetric games, and separates endpoint-determined leading behavior from a curvature-sensitive period intercept. This is not merely a renamed center or a table recomputation; it predicts long-orbit physical-time statistics for a six-coefficient quartic class. Weak convergence and deterministic scope are explicitly stated.
